d: The choir, led by Edwiga and Guisto, appears slowly and gently and decorates the hut with flowers and wreaths during the singing
Countrymen, shepherds and hunters appear festively decorated, among them Edwiga and Guisto. Girls and young lads carry gifts - flowers and fruits - for Troila
Mauregato, in hunting costumes, appears with entourage
The entourage of the king, servants, hunters, pages etc. are joyfully aroused

Solemn arrival of Adolfo and the victorious troops, led by festively decorated virgins, troubadours and citizens of the city. After the warriors are gathered, Mauregato appears, at the hand of Estrella, followed by greats of the empire and the court state. Mauregato takes place on the throne, on his side Estrella
Women and girls of the countrymen and hunters, Edwiga and an old man are on stage when the curtain is raised and look anxiously to the left, where the neighbouring kingdom is commemorated
Adolfo comes from the left and pulls Estrella with him forcibly
Warriors from Leon come fleeing from the left
